name: x2611_15210_thm3_1
original:
For every finite abelian group $H$ whose exponent divides $n$ ,

(3.1)

 $A_{n}(H\oplus C_{n}^{5})\ \geq\ 12\,A_{n}(H\oplus C_{n})+8\,A_{n}(H\oplus C_{m}).$ 

Suppose moreover that $c>0$ and $\beta>1$ satisfy $A_{n}(C_{m}^{s})\geq c\beta^{s}$ for
all $s\geq 0$ . Let $\alpha$ be the unique positive root of

(3.2)

 $\alpha^{5}=12\alpha+8\beta.$ 

Then $\alpha>2$ , and for every $r\geq 1$ ,

(3.3)

 $\mathsf{s}(C_{n}^{r})\ \geq\ c\Bigl(\frac{2}{\alpha}\Bigr)^{4}\alpha^{r}+1.$
